rules.description: Archive exceeds an extraction limit (size, entries, depth or ratio).
Archive holds an unsafe path, link, special file or disallowed file type.
pack.json is missing.
pack.json does not match the manifest schema.
The version is not semver x.y.z.
The version is not greater than the pack's newest version.
minEngineVersion is not a three-part engine version.
A requires entry names a pack the publisher cannot read.
A part declared in pack.json is absent from the archive.
The archive holds a part that pack.json does not declare; it is shown as extracted.
A scope or pack name is not ASCII.
The name is a reserved word.
The name collides with a verified domain label.
The name is within edit distance 2 of, or confusable with, a popular pack.
The name is a near miss on a verified scope.
The name is visually confusable with a verified scope.
The name is a popular pack's name published under a scope close to that pack's scope.
A secret was detected; the value is never shown.
Prose names a credential or secret as something to read or send.
Prose directs the agent to send data to a network destination.
Code or prose fetches an executable from a URL.
Prose instructs the agent to install something from a URL.
A pipe-to-shell pattern appears in code or in prose telling the agent to run it.
A floating dependency version: latest, a range or an unpinned git ref.
A bidirectional control, zero-width or tag code point appears in text.
A text file is not valid UTF-8, so a scanner and an agent may read it differently.
A prompt-injection or tool-poisoning heuristic matched publisher-written text.
A prompt-injection heuristic matched the pitch or a tag.
Text is addressed to a reviewer, validator or AI evaluator.
An identifier mixes scripts.
A binary, or a file with NUL bytes at a path that is not a text path.
A coded check imports beyond the check SDK and the Go standard library, or a worker imports beyond @claudinite/sdk.
The pack uses a GitHub action that pack.json does not declare.
Executable content holds a static pattern that opens a network connection.
Executable content builds or loads code at run time.
Executable content decodes base64 or holds a long encoded string.
Executable content branches on the current date or time.
The pack declares no license.
The pack has no README.
A prose-only pack has no fixtures.
A style issue in a Markdown file.
